offers.title: Half-price AZ-900 through DataCamp
offers.validity: The code lasts 3 to 6 months. The email tells you the exact date.
offers.eligibility: Students. You need the GitHub Student Developer Pack, which comes with 3 months of DataCamp Premium for free.
steps: Sign up for the GitHub Student Developer Pack. GitHub will ask for proof that you're a student.
Inside the pack, claim the DataCamp offer. That gets you 3 months of Premium.
Do the Azure Fundamentals track. It's 4 courses, roughly 8 hours.
DataCamp emails the code, usually within 3 days. If it doesn't show up, ask their support.
offers.summary: If you're a student, finish DataCamp's Azure Fundamentals track and they'll email you a 50% off code for AZ-900.

offers.title: Half-price PL-300 through DataCamp
offers.validity: The code lasts 3 to 6 months. The email tells you the exact date.
offers.eligibility: Students. You need the GitHub Student Developer Pack, which comes with 3 months of DataCamp Premium for free.
steps: Get the GitHub Student Developer Pack and claim DataCamp Premium from it.
Work through the Data Analyst in Power BI track. Give yourself a few weeks, it's long.
Use the 50% code DataCamp sends you when you book PL-300.
offers.summary: Same deal as the AZ-900 one, but for the Power BI exam. The track is a lot longer, about 48 hours.

offers.title: Microsoft Virtual Training Days
offers.validity: Depends on the event. Check the email you get afterwards.
offers.eligibility: Anyone can join, but not every event comes with a voucher. The event page says if it does.
steps: Find a Fundamentals event on the Virtual Training Days page and check that it mentions a voucher.
Register and attend all the sessions.
Microsoft emails the voucher after the event.
offers.summary: Free online sessions run by Microsoft. Some of the Fundamentals ones come with a free exam voucher if you attend the whole thing.

offers.title: Microsoft Certification Week 2026
exams: 16 certs across Azure, AI, Security, GitHub, Fabric
offers.eligibility: You had to score 80% or more on your first LevelUp practice assessment.
offers.summary: A week of live training covering 16 certifications. If you scored 80% or more on your first LevelUp practice test, you could get a free voucher.

offers.title: 60 Days of Data & AI (Fabric and SQL)
offers.eligibility: Watch 2 Data Days sessions and finish 3 Microsoft Learn modules. There was a limited number, first come first served.
offers.summary: A free DP-600, DP-700 or DP-800 voucher for watching two Data Days sessions and finishing three Microsoft Learn modules.

offers.title: Microsoft AI Skills Fest 2026
offers.eligibility: Complete an eligible AI Skills Navigator playlist between 8 and 12 June 2026.
offers.summary: Finish one of the AI Skills Navigator playlists during the event and get a free exam voucher and a Credly badge.
